sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW MOVING THROUGH THE NRN ROCKIES WILL ADVANCE INTO THE NRN PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING REACHING THE UPPER MS VALLEY LATE SATURDAY NIGHT. THIS FEATURE WILL BE ACCOMPANIED BY A COLD FRONT THAT WILL ADVANCE SEWD THROUGH THE NRN PLAINS DURING THE AFTERNOON. BY LATE AFTERNOON THE FRONT SHOULD EXTEND FROM ND SWWD THROUGH SERN WY. A PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH WILL EXTEND FROM NEB NWD THROUGH THE CNTRL OR ERN DAKOTAS.

sections.title: CNTRL AND NRN PLAINS THROUGH UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: STORMS CURRENTLY MOVING THROUGH IA WILL LIKELY WEAKEN AND BY EARLY MORNING...AND THE REMNANT CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WILL LIKELY EXTEND FROM CNTRL IL WWD INTO NRN/CNTRL MO WITH A DEEPER BAROCLINIC ZONE FARTHER NORTH ACROSS SRN MN INTO THE SRN PARTS OF THE GREAT LAKES. WRN PORTIONS OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY MAY DRIFT NWD DURING THE DAY. RESERVOIR OF STRONG INSTABILITY CURRENTLY LOCATED OVER NEB WILL NOT LIKELY BE OVERTURNED BY FRIDAY NIGHTS CONVECTION. THEREFORE...WARM SECTOR SHOULD ONCE AGAIN BECOME VERY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE FROM 3000-4000 J/KG FROM NEB NWD INTO A PORTION OF SD...SWRN MN AND WRN IA. STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP WITHIN THE ZONE OF DEEPER FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH THE UPPER TROUGH AND ITS ATTENDANT COLD FRONT OVER THE WRN DAKOTAS. OTHER STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP ALONG THE PRE-FRONTAL CONVERGENCE BOUNDARY FROM CNTRL SD SWD INTO NEB...AND POSSIBLY IN VICINITY OF E-W BAROCLINIC ZONE OVER THE UPPER MS VALLEY. VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES WILL INCREASE WITH THE APPROACH OF UPPER TROUGH AND SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORMS. INITIAL THREATS WILL BE SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL...BUT THREAT FOR MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WIND SHOULD INCREASE AS STORMS EVENTUALLY GROW UPSCALE INTO AN MCS AND C

sections.title: OH VALLEY AND GREAT LAKES
sections.text: THE COMBINATION OF DIABATIC WARMING AND EWD ADVECTION OF HIGHER THETA-E AIR WILL CONTRIBUTE TO POTENTIAL FOR MODERATE INSTABILITY OVER THE OH VALLEY AND SRN GREAT LAKES REGION. HOWEVER...DESTABILIZATION COULD BE MITIGATED OR DELAYED SOMEWHAT DUE TO SWD SURGING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THIS MORNING. THIS REGION WILL REMAIN ON SRN FRINGE OF LARGE UPPER LOW OVER ERN CANADA WITH MODERATE NWLY FLOW ALOFT AND VERTICAL SHEAR AT LEAST MARGINALLY SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED STORMS. POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR STORMS TO DEVELOP IN VICINITY OF E-W BAROCLINIC ZONE DURING THE DAY. PRIMARY THREATS WILL BE ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL. ..DIAL/DEAN/JEWELL.. 06/26/2010

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: WESTERN U.S. UPPER TROUGH...A COMPOSITE OF NUMEROUS SMALLER SCALE PERTURBATIONS...WAS BEGINNING TO TRANSITION EAST FROM THE NRN ROCKIES EARLY TODAY. THIS WILL EVENTUALLY BRING STRONG HEIGHT FALLS ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS AND UPPER MS VALLEY AREAS TONIGHT. AT THE SURFACE...A BROAD AREA OF LOW PRESSURE WAS SITUATED OVER THE NRN AND CNTRL PLAINS THIS MORNING. THE SYNOPTIC WARM FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS LOW HAS BECOME A BIT ILL-DEFINED AND WAS SUBSTANTIALLY FRAGMENTED BY OVERNIGHT MCS ACTIVITY FROM IA TO IND. THE MCS OUTFLOW WILL LIKELY ACT AS A DE FACTO WARM FRONT...RETREATING NWD FROM IA TO SD/MN TODAY...AS SURFACE LOW CONSOLIDATES AND STRENGTHENS ACROSS THESE AREAS THROUGH THE EVENING. AS THE LARGER SCALE SYSTEM STRENGTHENS AND SURFACE LOW TRACKS NEWD TOWARD MN/WI...ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT WILL SWEEP SEWD FROM NRN HIGH PLAINS THROUGH MOST OF THE CNTRL PLAINS BY DAYBREAK SUNDAY. MUCH WEAKER MID LEVEL FLOW AND POORLY DEFINED DISTURBANCES WILL EXIST ACROSS THE SRN HALF OF THE CONUS...GENERALLY SOUTH OF 40N...ATOP A VERY WARM/MOIST AIRMASS.

sections.title: CNTRL/NRN PLAINS
sections.text: POORLY ORGANIZED MCS ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE DAKOTAS THIS MORNING WAS LIKELY BEING SUSTAINED BY MID LEVEL SHORT WAVE TROUGH CRESTING UPPER RIDGE AXIS AND ENHANCING MASS INFLOW AND DESTABILIZATION ON THE NOSE OF PLAINS NOCTURNAL LOW LEVEL JET. IT IS NOT ENTIRELY CLEAR HOW OR IF THIS EARLY-DAY ACTIVITY WILL INFLUENCE CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT LATER TODAY. HOWEVER...WATER VAPOR IMAGERY DEPICTS ADDITIONAL SHORT WAVE PERTURBATIONS EMANATING OUT OF THE ERN FLANK OF THE LARGER SCALE WRN TROUGH. THESE UPSTREAM DISTURBANCES WILL SUSTAIN DEEP LAYER ASCENT AND SURFACE LOW CONSOLIDATION ACROSS THE PLAINS TODAY AS WARM SECTOR AIRMASS...FROM NEB/IA TO SD/MN...UNDERGOES SIGNIFICANT DESTABILIZATION. PERSISTENT FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL ACT TO OVERCOME INHIBITION AND RESULT IN AN STEADY INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THROUGH THE AFTERNOON FROM PARTS OF WY/CO NEWD ACROSS THE DAKOTAS. OTHER STORMS MAY DEVELOP WITHIN THE LOW/TROUGH AXIS FROM SD TO NEB...AND POSSIBLY ALONG/NEAR THE REMNANT MCS OUTFLOW/WARM FRONT RETREATING NWD FROM THE MID MO VALLEY...FROM ERN NEB/IA INTO SRN MN. A BAND OF 40-50KT MID LEVEL FLOW...ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORT WAVE TROUGH MOVING FROM NEB INTO SD LATER THIS AFTERNOON...WI

sections.title: IND/OH
sections.text: IT IS POSSIBLE THAT FORWARD PROPAGATING PORTION OF MCS OUTFLOW COULD PROVIDE A FOCUS FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT AS AIRMASS ALONG AND NORTH OF THE OH RIVER UNDERGOES STRONG DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION. MID LEVEL FLOW WILL NOT BE PARTICULARLY STRONG...AND LARGE SCALE HEIGHT RISES ACROSS THE AREA MAY ALSO LIMITED STORM COVERAGE AND DURATION. HOWEVER...A FEW STORMS COULD PRODUCE DAMAGING WIND GUSTS LATER THIS AFTERNOON OR EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: SOUTH
sections.text: IT APPEARS THAT IT WILL BE ANOTHER DAY OF SCATTERED MICROBURST ACTIVITY AS AIRMASS BECOMES STRONGLY UNSTABLE AND WEAKLY CAPPED ACROSS THE SOUTH. VERY WEAK MID LEVEL FLOW AND POORLY DEFINED FOCUSING MECHANISMS MAKE IT DIFFICULT TO CORRAL THIS POTENTIAL SEVERE WEATHER WITH ANYTHING MORE THAN A LARGE LOW PROBABILITY AREA. ..CARBIN.. 06/26/2010

sections.title: CENTRAL/NRN PLAINS
sections.text: WV IMAGERY AND MORNING ANALYSIS SHOW BROAD UPPER TROUGH SHIFTING EWD FROM CENTRAL MT SWD INTO NRN UT...WHICH WAS ALSO AIDING IN THE EJECTION OF ANOTHER IMPULSE NEWD THROUGH NERN CO. THESE TWO SYSTEMS SHOULD BE PRIMARY CONTRIBUTORS FOR SEVERE THREAT THIS PERIOD. AT THE SURFACE...A BROAD AREA OF SURFACE LOW PRESSURE WAS SITUATED OVER WRN NEB/SD WITH A SURFACE TROUGH/FRONT EXTENDING SWD INTO WRN KS. AS UPPER TROUGH APPROACHES FROM THE WEST... SURFACE LOW SHOULD CONSOLIDATE AND DEEPEN SLIGHTLY AS IT SHIFTS EWD INTO SRN MN THIS EVE AND WI OVERNIGHT. SUBTLE WARM FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES...WITH ONE EXTENDING FROM CENTRAL SD SEWD ALONG THE IA/NEB AND ANOTHER IN FAR SRN MN...ARE EXPECTED TO CONSOLIDATE AND SHARPEN BY LATE AFTERNOON IN SERN SD/SRN MN AS THE LOW MOVES EWD. AT MID MORNING...MOSTLY CLOUDY SKIES AND A FEW CLUSTERS OF ELEVATED STORMS WERE LOCATED ACROSS THE DAKOTAS...WITHIN WEAK WARM ADVECTION REGIME. ALTHOUGH MUCAPES AROUND 1500 J/KG AND CLOUD BEARING VERTICAL SHEAR MAY SUPPORT ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL INTO THE EARLY AFTERNOON HOURS...THE GREATER SEVERE THREAT LIKELY WILL WAIT UNTIL LATER TODAY AS STRONGER FORCING SPREADS IN FROM THE W AND SW AND GREATER BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATI

sections.title: IL/IN/OH
sections.text: OUTFLOW FROM OVERNIGHT MCS COULD PROVIDE A FOCUS FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT LATER TODAY AS AIR MASS UNDERGOES DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION. THE MID LEVEL FLOW WILL NOT BE PARTICULARLY STRONG AND UPPER WAVE CURRENTLY MOVING THROUGH THE AREA MAY RESULT IN WEAK SUBSIDENCE FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS. HOWEVER... CONVERGENCE MAY INCREASE BY EVENING AS LOW LEVEL JET SLOWLY STRENGTHENS TO 20 KT. IF STORMS DEVELOP...INSTABILITY WOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE.

sections.title: SRN ATLANTIC COASTAL STATES WWD INTO OK
sections.text: VERY MOIST...WARM AND HUMID AIR MASS SHOULD RESULT IN SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS INTO THE EVENING HOURS. WHILE A FEW WET...SHORT LIVED MICROBURSTS APPEAR LIKELY...WEAK MID LEVEL FLOW/SHEAR AND POORLY DEFINED FOCUSING MECHANISMS MEANS THESE FEW EVENTS WOULD OCCUR WITHIN A LARGE AREA...SO ONLY LOW WIND PROBABILITIES ARE FORECAST. ..IMY/SMITH.. 06/26/2010

sections.title: NERN NEB
sections.text: OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED THE AIR MASS ALONG THE MID MO VALLEY HAS BECOME VERY UNSTABLE...THUS FAR THIS AFTERNOON...WITH MLCAPE VALUES EXCEEDING 4000 J/KG. GIVEN THAT STRONGER INSTABILITY EXTENDS SWD INTO NEB AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WILL INCREASE SWD ACROSS PARTS OF NERN NEB/NWRN IA INTO THE EVENING WITH APPROACH OF UPSTREAM TROUGH...MODERATE RISK/SEVERE PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN EXPANDED SWD. VERY LARGE HAIL AND EVENTUAL TORNADO DEVELOPMENT... SOME STRONG TO SIGNIFICANT...REMAIN LIKELY ACROSS THE MODERATE RISK AREA INTO THE EVENING.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: AIR MASS OVER SERN MT/NERN WY HAS BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE IN ADVANCE OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH...CURRENTLY EXTENDING FROM ALBERTA/ WRN SASKATCHEWAN TO WRN WY PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THIS TROUGH WILL SPREAD EWD AND SUPPORT ADDITIONAL TSTMS ACROSS ERN MT/NERN WY THIS AFTERNOON WITH ACTIVITY SHIFTING EWD INTO THE DAKOTAS. GIVEN STRONG EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR /40-50 KT/ AND MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY SUPERCELLS AND LINE SEGMENTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THREATS FOR PRIMARILY HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: CENTRAL/ERN ND
sections.text: TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP AND SPREAD EWD ACROSS CENTRAL/ERN ND...POSING A SEVERE WEATHER THREAT GIVEN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS IN THIS REGION OF THE NRN PLAINS. THIS INSTABILITY COMBINED WITH STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR /AROUND 50 KT/ SUGGESTS SUPERCELLS ARE POSSIBLE WITH FORECAST SOUNDINGS INDICATING HAIL... SOME VERY LARGE...MAY OCCUR ACROSS CENTRAL/ERN ND. THUS... SIGNIFICANT HAIL PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN EXTENDED NWD TO ACCOUNT FOR THIS THREAT. SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1134 PROVIDES ADDITIONAL MESOSCALE DETAILS.

sections.title: CENTRAL/SRN MO
sections.text: GIVEN REGIONAL RADAR TRENDS...LOW SEVERE WIND PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN ADDED TO CENTRAL MO.

sections.title: SRN DELMARVA/ERN VA/ERN NC
sections.text: MINOR ADJUSTMENTS TO THE LOW SEVERE WIND PROBABILITY AND GENERAL TSTM LINE WERE MADE ACROSS THIS AREA PER TRENDS IN REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY. ..PETERS.. 06/26/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT SAT JUN 26 2010/

sections.title: PARTS OF THE CENTRAL AND NRN PLAINS/UPPER MS VALLEY REGION
sections.text: VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS PERSISTS ACROSS THE MID MO VALLEY AND VICINITY...WHERE WIDESPREAD SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING. AREA OF MOST CONCENTRATED EVENING/OVERNIGHT SEVERE POTENTIAL WILL REMAIN FROM PARTS OF SERN SD/NERN NEB EWD INTO SRN MN AND IA...NEAR AND S OF THE SURFACE WARM FRONT LYING ROUGHLY W-E ACROSS SRN SD/SRN MN. WITH SWLY LOW-LEVEL JET PROGGED TO CONTINUE INCREASING ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS AND WARM ADVECTION MAXIMIZED INTO THIS AREA...STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO EXPAND/GROW INTO A LARGE MCS -- ACCOMPANIED BY SUBSTANTIAL SEVERE POTENTIAL AS WELL AS A THREAT FOR A COUPLE OF TORNADOES. THIS SYSTEM SHOULD SPREAD EWD/ESEWD ACROSS MN/IA THIS EVENING...AND CONTINUE AS FAR E AS WRN WI OVERNIGHT. FARTHER W/NW...STRONG MID-LEVEL SHORT-WAVE TROUGH CROSSING THE NRN HIGH PLAINS MAY CONTINUE TO SUPPORT STRONG/LOCALLY-SEVERE STORMS IN MODERATELY-UNSTABLE AIRMASS FROM NWRN MN/ERN ND SWWD ACROSS CENTRAL SD INTO NWRN AND CENTRAL NEB. HOWEVER...SLOW STABILIZATION OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER THROUGH THIS EVENING SHOULD LEAD TO AN EVENTUAL DECREASE IN POTENTIAL OVERNIGHT. ..GOSS.. 06/27/2010
